title: Credit-card EMI and reward programmes - support procedure
content: In the demo, ask an agent to review a synthetic purchase for EMI eligibility or inspect the fictional rewards record. Read the configured offer before confirming any conversion; the assistant cannot redeem real rewards or promise approval.
